This implies a potential role for Azacitidine in modulating Dnmt1 activity, possibly through the metabolic conversion of Decitabine. The presence of an N-Glycosyl Compound as the lowest common ancestor suggests a broader metabolic pathway, though the direct interaction between Azacitidine and Dnmt1 remains unconfirmed. The evidence supports a possible indirect mechanism, but further validation is needed to establish a direct causal relationship.
